[EN] You delivered carving material to Dolme and received a Horn Helm.
[ES] Entregaste material de tallado a Dolme y recibiste un Horn Helm.

[EN] , welcome to the beach party.

If you're interested in procuring a horn helm, you might be out of luck. Lots of customers looking to buy horn helms this year, and I bring near enough horns with me.

I tell you what, though, : You go get me two arachnen horns from Serpentis Isle, and I'll make you a horn helm. Deal?
[ES] , bienvenido a la fiesta en la playa.

Si estás interesado en conseguir un horn helm, tal vez no tengas suerte. Hay muchos clientes buscando comprar horn helm este año, y traigo casi suficientes cuernos conmigo.

Te diré algo, sin embargo, : Vas y me traes dos cuernos de arachnen de Serpentis Isle, y te haré un horn helm. ¿Trato?

[EN] Well done, ! These are some fine horns, and they should last me through the rest of the day.

Here's your horn helm, and thank you.
[ES] ¡Bien hecho, ! Estos son unos cuernos excelentes, y deberían durarme el resto del día.

Aquí tienes tu horn helm y gracias.

[EN] I know getting arachnen horns isn't easy, . But I'd very much appreciate it if you could hurry.
[ES] Sé que conseguir cuernos de arachnen no es fácil, . Pero te agradecería muchísimo si pudieras darte prisa.
